version.changelog: Clarified skill name for better discoverability

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only CEO/advisory skill whose requirements and instructions are internally consistent with its stated purpose and do not request additional system access or network calls.

dimensions.detail: The name and description promise executive guidance and templates; all included files are guidance docs (strategy, finance, board, etc.). There are no declared binaries, env vars, or config paths that would be inconsistent with a purely advisory skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the companion files contain only procedural guidance, checklists, and templates. The runtime instructions explicitly state no external API calls, no persistent storage, and no file access beyond the included auxiliaries. There are no steps that instruct the agent to read unrelated system files or exfiltrate data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — the skill is instruction-only, which minimizes disk/write/execute risk. There are no downloads or package installs to evaluate.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no primary credential, and no config path requirements. That matches the simple advisory nature of the skill; no disproportionate credential access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags show always:false and normal model invocation (autonomy allowed), which is expected for skills. The skill does not request permanent presence or modify other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and appears coherent with its stated goal of providing CEO-level frameworks and templates. Before installing, consider: (1) the SKILL.md asserts it will not make network calls or store data — ensure your runtime/platform enforces that, because the skill itself cannot enforce the host environment; (2) do not paste confidential financials, term sheets, or private PII into the skill unless you trust the agent runtime and other installed skills (combined capabilities can change risk); (3) verify the publisher/source if provenance matters to you (metadata shows an owner ID and a homepage but no known publisher name); and (4) if you plan to let agents act autonomously with multiple skills enabled, review cross-skill permission boundaries, since autonomous invocation plus other network-capable skills can increase exposure.
